title: Space Slugs: Week 3
author: The_Pumpkin_Lady
selftext:
Definitely a less visually interesting week, but I promised myself that I'd post here weekly.

Most of the core systems are developed and I'm in that unsexy iteration phase. My working cycle is about 2 hours of play testing and writing bugs, then \~6-8 hours of generation.

The validations that Claude writes are working well and there has been no significant regression of bugs. Everything feels to be moving forward.

  
**Wins**

I've got the steam page setup ([Intergalactic Space Slugs from Space](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5546240/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=unpaid&utm_campaign=weeklydev)) and enough marketing material (I hope) to begin wishlists. I'm experimenting with paid ads and I'll post a full report next week with my findings & metrics.

*Current Wishlist: 10*

  
**Observations**

With my (Claude's) ledger system I run development in a single Claude session; with context stored as a json file and associated to the Epic.

To reduce token burn while operating in this method, I setup an auto compact rule at 500k which appears to have cut my usage by about 30%.
